Resources & release status

Find the public code, gated datasets, model checkpoints and the source guides behind these instructions.

Official release locations

ResourceLocationAccess
CodeSIPAIR-Elastic/DexArena ↗Public source; clone the repository and consult its LICENSE.
Data, meshes and checkpointsSIPAIR/DexArena ↗Gated dataset repository; request access once, then authenticate with the Hub CLI.
PaperarXiv record ↗ · PDF ↗Public preprint.
CitationBibTeX and attributionCopy or download the canonical .bib entry.
ResultsManuscript LeaderboardSix fixed baseline tables, downloadable JSON/CSV and the score protocol.

Code, data, model backbones and scene assets may carry different licenses or access conditions. Consult each original repository or model card; do not assume the code license covers every external asset.

Download only what you need

# From the DexArena code repository, after requesting dataset access:
hf auth login
hf download SIPAIR/DexArena --repo-type dataset --include "assets/**" --local-dir tasks
hf download SIPAIR/DexArena --repo-type dataset --include "data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1/**" --local-dir .
hf download SIPAIR/DexArena --repo-type dataset --include "ckpt/act/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1/**" --local-dir .

The checkpoint collection is much larger than a single stage dataset. Inspect counts, sizes and model-specific dependencies before a bulk download. Store your dataset revision and checkpoint hashes with the evaluation records.

What is not included

  • The hardware teleoperation stack is not part of the public release; the released pipeline starts at review/export.
  • The published GR00T N1.7 checkpoints use the multi-instruction protocol, not the single-instruction checkpoints behind the manuscript numbers.
  • π0.5 packages are inference-only overlays on a separately downloaded Base, not full training-resume checkpoints.
  • Community submission intake and a hosted evaluation API are not open. The reproduction checklist describes local evidence, not an upload service.

For a guided first run, start with the tutorial.
